text.description_html:
Acorn RK3BQ, Offset 3 x 6 Inch Shutter Hinges

Acorn's shutter hinge has a rough black finish that mimics the texture of naturally weathered iron for an authentic, antique look. It is made with a curved offset to throw shutter clear of window. The 3 x 6 Inch Offset Black Shutter Hinge comes packaged as a pair with mounting hardware.

Features and Specifications of the Black Shutter Hinge:

  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Height: 3"
  • Length (open): 6"
  • Maximum Throw: 3-1/2
  • Hinge width should be equal to twice the depth of the reveal.
  • Hinge is reversible with loose pin.
  • Packaged Includes: (2) hinges and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

    • Priced and Sold as a Pair (2 hinges). Recommended 1 pair per shutter so 2 pairs per window.
